messages:
Alex Kim: Heads-up: PR #13131 is blocked by CI — snapshot test failing in render-service e2e. Local runs are flaky (passes ~9/10). Anyone seen this pattern?
ci-bot: [ci] Job failed: render-service-e2e (shard 7)
ci-bot: ```
AssertionError: snapshot mismatch at components/header.test.js
- expected: <header v1>
+ received: <header v1 -- animated>
Stack: at render (header.test.js:42)
```
Jamie Patel: I ran into something similar yesterday on shard 3. Usually nondeterministic timing. Can we do a targeted rerun?
Sasha Li: @ci-bot please rerun shard=7 for PR #13131. If you want, I can run `yarn test:e2e --shard=7` locally and tail logs.
ci-bot: Command accepted: rerun queued (job id 98321). ETA ~2m.
Maria Gomez: I'll watch the rerun. Alex — if it keeps failing do you want to update the snapshot or we try to stabilize the test?
Alex Kim: Prefer stabilize if it's a timing flake. I'll try to capture the seed / failing trace. Will avoid snapshot update unless it's a legit UI change.
Ryan Chen: Policy: do not update snapshots to silence flakes. If rerun passes, hold merge until we get 2 approvals + CI green twice. :eyes:
Jamie Patel: Agreed. Also I'll create a short follow-up issue to flake-hunt the header snapshot.
Sasha Li: Rerun completed: passed once, failed on second run. Logs: https://ci.internal/98321/log (looks like a race on animation frame).
Alex Kim: Thanks — logs show timing variance: network idle vs animation. Adding a small wait could stabilize.
Maria Gomez: Quick patch idea: add `await waitForNetworkIdle()` before snapshot capture in header.test.js and mark with TODO to re-evaluate. I'll draft a tiny PR.
Ryan Chen: I'm fine with that minimal fix for now as long as snapshots don't change. Can someone review the stabilization PR quickly? @Jamie @Sasha
Jamie Patel: I'll take a look after my standup (~30m). :thumbsup:
ci-bot: PR #13131 rerun summary: 1/3 failures — flaky flagged.
Alex Kim: Ok holding merge for now. Creating issue FLK-142 to track recurring header snapshot flake.
Sasha Li: Filed FLK-142 with steps to repro and attached logs. Assigned to Alex + Sasha.
Maria Gomez: Thanks. If the stabilization PR lands and two approvals + two green runs happen, we can merge. Otherwise we keep it blocked.
Alex Kim: Will post updates in this thread when I push the stabilizing PR. Thanks everyone for quick responses.
